description: The existential representative comparison on parity classes is not antisymmetric: the distinct even and odd classes compare in both directions, witnessed by 0 ≤ 1 and 1 ≤ 2, with 2 in the class of 0.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.parity_representative_order_not_antisymmetric :
  have q := Quotient.mk Lemmatheca.Entry.EquivalenceRelations.paritySetoid;
  q 0 ≠ q 1 ∧
    q 2 = q 0 ∧
      0 ≤ 1 ∧
        1 ≤ 2 ∧
          Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.parityRepresentativeLE (q 0) (q 1) ∧
            Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.parityRepresentativeLE (q 1) (q 0) ∧
              ¬Std.Antisymm Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.parityRepresentativeLE
